title: Configuration after an oracle call
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Turing machine with $k>0$ work tapes, let $\iota$ be an injection from $1+k$ virtual tape indices into the $k'$ work-tape indices of a configuration $d$ over input $x$, and suppose every tape indexed by $\iota(j)$ is blank in $d$ and its head is at cell $0$. For a state $q$ of $C$ and Boolean word $z$, embedding the virtual-host configuration initialized with $z$ on its first work tape, empty contents on its other work tapes, boundary tag true, the input-head position of $d$, and the output of $d$ as its output prefix yields the configuration obtained from $d$ by setting its state to $(q,\mathrm{true})$ and replacing the tape at index $\iota(\text{first virtual bank index})$ by the buffer containing $z$; all other configuration data remains as in $d$.
